observation: A discontinuous planar spline query returns a one-sided span location; point_at without a side correctly refuses the discontinuous knot with Boundary. This alone is not a false geometry result.
Both original UV knot sides map exactly to the query, but only one chart location was returned. The preserved ordinary regression now requires two source chart locations.

The standalone native Curve3 NURBS constructor rejects internal knot multiplicity degree+1 with InvalidKnotMultiplicity. The speculative inverse mismatch is not an admitted native spatial input and is not counted as an implementation failure or geometric completion.
